newsitem.title: CHINA: China '97 lead output seen at 450,000 tonnes.
newsitem.headline: China '97 lead output seen at 450,000 tonnes.

text.p: China'a lead output is expected to reach 450,000 tonnes in 1997, the Economic Information Daily said on Friday.
The newspaper did not give comparative figures.
Domestic lead prices are expected to decline in 1997, with the annual average price likely to reach 6,500 yuan ($783) per tonne, it said.
China's lead production would be restrained by short supply of concentrates in 1997, it said. Exports would decline because of weak international prices, it said, but gave no further details.
